title: Retimed nine-stage complex + kernel bit: conditional kappa 0.000998390813251625
body:
Conditional **κ = 0.000998390813251625** (`7987126506013/8000000000000000`), **0.014791889125625176% above #382**. Pair #382's unchanged kernel bit supplier with #365's complex retiming lifted into #377's nine-stage layout. Complex coarse saving becomes `999388595603943/10^18`; bit coarse saving remains `251726760077483/250000000000000000`. The complex side binds.

The retiming removes 72 global paid calls while preserving rank mass, stock, deficit 2496, maximum child 48, halving degree two, the 15445/20161 row bound, and the 49B induction gap. This contributes the source-bound composition and fresh global replay; the component constructions belong to their credited authors.

**Validation:** full local packaged replay PASS at `ad7647ef25b1df0e51189a41072d08a928d759d5`, including the complete #382 bit replay, all #377 baseline stages, #365 reconstruction, and the changed component's exact local/Clifford/data-phase/global-template/finite-invoice/independent-template/two-moment checks and 47-constraint assembly. An initial end-to-end attempt found Python's default decimal-integer parsing limit while reading a 9,634-digit exact finite certificate; the current head enables exact large-integer parsing and the fresh full run passes. GitHub Python 3.11/3.14 and broader CI are still running.

**Comparison update:** #384 and #387 are numerically above this PR. This package preserves a fully replayed composition of #365's local retiming with #377; it makes no claim to exceed those later values.

Reproduce: `python -B research/e8-retimed-nine-composition/verify.py /fresh/output`. The harness first replays all three pinned suppliers, then constructs and verifies the changed nine-stage component. Original sources stay immutable; every derived change is hash-recorded. Full sources, licenses, proof documents, expected rational prices, and CI are included.

**Scope:** retains #382's kernel entrance-completion assumptions and open seven-block PR234-style geometry/full finite-bill obligations at m=56; retains its degree-two guard and #377's m=73 compressed-window, arbitrary-dirty-bank, Clifford/compiler, symbolic-cover, common-grid, row and analytic interfaces. No new Lean proof or unconditional multiplication exponent is claimed.

Credits: Ali Romman / aliromman (#365); Zhihao Chen / jacklightChen with OpenAI Codex (#377); Chafik Boukhalfa / chafreaky with Claude (#382); Jacob Sussman, DaysSky, Dylan Crow and the contributors credited in the retained notices. Composition prepared by Rohan Arun with OpenAI Codex assistance. The three joint-dual metadata files reuse #318's source-pin repair without a mathematical change.
